tasks.label: Lint
tasks.command: ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/ruff check src tests && ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/ruff format --check src tests

tasks.label: Format
tasks.command: ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/ruff format src tests && ${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/ruff check --fix src tests

tasks.label: Set up the development environment
tasks.command: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'
